description: Header file defining platform-specific canvas creation functions and error handling for Skia graphics library integration, including platform-specific includes and functions for Windows and Unix-like systems.

classes.name: skia::OnFailureType
classes.description: Enumeration for handling failures during canvas creation, either crashing or returning null.

methods.name: CreatePlatformCanvas
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific SkCanvas with default failure handling.

methods.name: TryCreateBitmapCanvas
methods.description: Attempts to create a platform-specific SkCanvas, returning null on failure.

methods.name: ReadPixels
methods.description: Copies pixels from a SkCanvas into an SkBitmap, possibly fetching from GPU memory.

methods.name: GetWritablePixels
methods.description: Provides writable access to the pixels backing a SkCanvas.
